WITH ingredients AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    (923645, 'omeprazole', 'PPI'),

    (953076, 'famotidine', 'H2 blocker'),
    (961047, 'ranitidine', 'H2 blocker'),
    (950696, 'nizatidine', 'H2 blocker')
  ) AS v(ingredient_concept_id, ingredient_name, drug_class)
), drug_desc AS (
  SELECT i.ingredient_concept_id, i.ingredient_name, i.drug_class, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM ingredients i
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.ingredient_concept_id
), first_exposure AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, dd.ingredient_name, dd.drug_class, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS first_exposure_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug_desc dd ON dd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY de.person_id, dd.ingredient_name, dd.drug_class
), cdi_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (193688, 4307981, 45763575, 37160835, 37161038, 37161037, 44811658, 37312146, 37169724, 37169725, 4225690)
  UNION SELECT 193688 UNION SELECT 4307981 UNION SELECT 45763575 UNION SELECT 37160835 UNION SELECT 37161038 UNION SELECT 37161037 UNION SELECT 44811658 UNION SELECT 37312146 UNION SELECT 37169724 UNION SELECT 37169725 UNION SELECT 4225690
), cdi_after AS (
  SELECT fe.person_id, fe.ingredient_name, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS first_cdi_date, COUNT(*) AS cdi_code_count
  FROM first_exposure fe
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = fe.person_id
  JOIN cdi_concepts cc ON cc.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE co.condition_start_date > fe.first_exposure_date
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(year, 5, fe.first_exposure_date)
  GROUP BY fe.person_id, fe.ingredient_name
)
SELECT fe.drug_class, fe.ingredient_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fe.person_id) AS exposed_patients,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.person_id) AS patients_with_cdi_within_5y,
       SUM(COALESCE(ca.cdi_code_count,0)) AS cdi_condition_records_within_5y,
       CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ca.person_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fe.person_id),0) AS decimal(8,3)) AS percent_exposed_with_cdi_5y
FROM first_exposure fe
LEFT JOIN cdi_after ca ON ca.person_id = fe.person_id AND ca.ingredient_name = fe.ingredient_name
GROUP BY fe.drug_class, fe.ingredient_name
ORDER BY patients_with_cdi_within_5y DESC, cdi_condition_records_within_5y DESC;
